verdict.rationale: The product has a public GitHub repository (omnirush-ai/omnirush-gui). Its README includes a from-source dev command (`pnpm --filter @omnirush/desktop dev`), which suggests the app's source is readable there. However, nothing in the evidence names a license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unsupported. missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache/GPL file or badge), explicit confirmation that the full app source (not just binaries via releases) is published, independent corroboration.
